description: This file defines the AuthManager class responsible for handling authentication logic, token management, and session locking in an Android app.

classes.name: AuthManager
classes.description: Manages user authentication, token storage, session locking, and token refresh logic.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently logged in based on stored tokens.

methods.name: currentTokens
methods.description: Retrieves the current token pair if available.

methods.name: lockApp
methods.description: Locks the app session, requiring re-authentication.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a demo login by generating tokens locally and setting lock state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens and unlocks the app.

methods.name: isAccessTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks if the access token has expired or is about to expire.

methods.name: getValidAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures a valid access token is available, refreshing if necessary.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Simulates token refresh by generating a new access token.
